Let \(X=(0,t)\), where \(0\le t\le 7\). Since \(XY\parallel QR\), \(Y\) has \(y\)-coordinate \(t\). On \(PR\), whose equation is
\[
y=7-\frac78 u,
\]
we get
\[
t=7-\frac78 u \implies u=8-\frac{8t}{7}.
\]
So \(Z=(8-\frac{8t}{7},0)\). Then
\[
XZ^2=t^2+\left(8-\frac{8t}{7}\right)^2
=64-\frac{128}{7}t+\frac{113}{49}t^2.
\]
This quadratic is minimized at
\[
t=\frac{128/7}{2\cdot 113/49}=\frac{448}{113},
\]
which lies in \([0,7]\). The minimum value is
\[
XZ^2=64-\frac{4096}{113}=\frac{3136}{113}.
\]
Thus
\[
XZ=\sqrt{\frac{3136}{113}}=\frac{56}{\sqrt{113}}
=\frac{56\sqrt{113}}{113}.
\]
\[
\boxed{\frac{56\sqrt{113}}{113}\text{ cm}}
\]
